text:
Amy (DevEx): Hey team — quick check: we'd like to 'lock' the quickstarts + sample apps docs and cut the changelog entries for the release tomorrow. Can owners confirm PRs are merged or give a hard blocker by EOD? :eyes:

Raj (Docs): Docs side is mostly done. Two doc PRs outstanding: #482 (Windows notes) and #489 (auth examples). Both are review-ready, just waiting on final wording. I can merge once the SDK PR is stable.

Oliver (SDK): SDK has one pending bump PR for the quickstart sample (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/776). Tests are flaky on CI job `linux-integration-3`. If that stays flaky we might need to ship the code without the binary bump and land docs referencing the previous artifact.

Leah (QA): Re: flaky test — I'm seeing a consistent failure in `integration/test_sample_app.py::test_startup_on_arm` with the new container. Log excerpt:
```
AssertionError: service did not respond within 30s
docker logs quickstart_sample | tail -n 50
```
I'm running one-off locally to reproduce but timeout keeps happening.

devex-ci-bot: nightly-smoke (commit 4f2a1b3) — linux-integration-3: FAILED after 4 attempts. See: https://ci.internal/redwood/776/builds/3421 :x:

Oliver (SDK): ack. I'll drop a retry fix in the PR now, and if CI still flakes I vote to decouple the quickstart binary bump from the docs lock. We need docs to go out for customers.

Kevin (PM): We're tight on the release timeline. If there's a risk the sample binary causes the release to slip, prefer docs + changelog to go and ship the binary bump in a patch. Can we agree owners and a gating rule? My proposal: docs/changelog merged by 12:00 PT tomorrow, SDK binary bump OK to defer if CI fails 3x.

Amy (DevEx): Sounds good. Ownership plan: Raj will merge doc PRs once SDK decides on bump (Raj please merge by EOD tomorrow). Oliver to either get CI green or mark the bump as deferred by 10:30 PT tomorrow. Leah to validate the startup test once Oliver posts the retry fix. Kevin ✅ on the gating rule.

Raj (Docs): I'll queue the merge and do a quick sanity pass once the `sdk` PR decision is posted. If Oliver marks deferred, I'll update the quickstart doc to reference the existing artifact and add a short TODO in the changelog entry.

Oliver (SDK): PR updated with a retry patch, pushed now. If CI still fails, I'll add `defer-binary-bump: true` to the PR description and ping here.

Leah (QA): I'll rerun the failing test after the patch — ETA 30m. Will post results here.

devex-ci-bot: PR 776 — linux-integration-3: RETRY #1 started (triggered by Oliver).

Amy (DevEx): Thanks all. Two small asks before we close the thread: (1) Whoever defers the bump, leave an explicit note in the changelog entry like "binary bump deferred — will ship as patch"; (2) Raj, add a short doc footnote if the sample artifact differs from the main SDK version.

Oliver (SDK): noted, will do both.

Leah (QA): RETRY result: integration test still times out locally. Filing bug #1209 and attaching logs.

Oliver (SDK): OK I'm marking the bump deferred and updated PR description with `defer-binary-bump: true`. ping @Raj for doc merge.

Raj (Docs): Merged #482 and #489. Changelog entry added with the deferred note. Quickstarts site build kicked off: https://deploy.internal/quickstarts/preview/ (should be up in ~10m). :rocket:

Amy (DevEx): Awesome — final check: anyone blocking the docs/changelog release now?

Kevin (PM): No blockers from product side. Good to ship.

Amy (DevEx): Great — closing the loop. Owners: Raj (docs merge), Oliver (follow-up binary patch), Leah (QA bug triage). If anything changes, reply here. Thanks! :tada:
